title: 12 ETF fights that reveal where an AI would park your money: SPY vsMDY, SCHD vs KNG, QQQ vs SCHB. Which side are you on?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Twelve new ETF head-to-heads, and fees and yield do a lot of the  
talking. SCHD charges 0.06% vs 0.74% for KNG, SPYD yields about 4.3%  
vs about 2.4% for SDY, and QQQI pays roughly 14-15%. The AI picked a  
winner in every fight. Which side are you on?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. SPY vs MDY\*\* — The most heavily traded ETF on earth vs mid-caps  
with a beta of about 1.19. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown  
is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/spy-vs-mdy-large-cap-stability-edges-out-mid-cap-volatility-39722/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/spy-vs-mdy-large-cap-stability-edges-out-mid-cap-volatility-39722/)  
  
\*\*2. QQQ vs SCHB\*\* — The Nasdaq-100 at 0.18% vs roughly 2,400 U.S.  
stocks in one fund. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in  
the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/qqq-vs-schb-concentrated-nasdaq-100-growth-or-broad-u-s-market-exposure-39532/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/qqq-vs-schb-concentrated-nasdaq-100-growth-or-broad-u-s-market-exposure-39532/)  
  
\*\*3. ARKK vs SPY\*\* — Cathie Wood's disruptive-innovation bet vs the  
plain S&P 500. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the  
link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/arkk-vs-spy-weighing-a-focused-innovation-etf-against-broad-market-stability-39710/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/arkk-vs-spy-weighing-a-focused-innovation-etf-against-broad-market-stability-39710/)  
  
\*\*4. MGK vs VUG\*\* — Two Vanguard growth ETFs with a 0.99 correlation:  
about 59 mega caps vs about 140 to 160 names. Which one does the AI  
favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/mgk-vs-vug-weighing-concentration-against-broader-diversification-in-vanguard-growth-etfs-39724/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/mgk-vs-vug-weighing-concentration-against-broader-diversification-in-vanguard-growth-etfs-39724/)  
  
\*\*5. SDY vs SPYD\*\* — Roughly 4.3% yield at 0.07% vs about 2.4% at  
0.35%. Yield chasers vs dividend aristocrats. Which one does the AI  
favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/sdy-vs-spyd-dividend-aristocrats-or-high-yield-s-p-500-picks-39721/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/sdy-vs-spyd-dividend-aristocrats-or-high-yield-s-p-500-picks-39721/)  
  
\*\*6. KNG vs SCHD\*\* — 0.06% vs 0.74% in fees. Covered-call income vs  
dividend quality. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the  
link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/kng-vs-schd-high-yield-options-strategy-or-low-cost-dividend-quality-39575/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/kng-vs-schd-high-yield-options-strategy-or-low-cost-dividend-quality-39575/)  
  
\*\*7. SOXQ vs XSD\*\* — The 30 biggest chip stocks, cap-weighted, vs  
about 44 holdings at near-equal weight. Which one does the AI favor?  
The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/soxq-vs-xsd-semiconductor-etfs-in-the-ai-driven-market-39734/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/soxq-vs-xsd-semiconductor-etfs-in-the-ai-driven-market-39734/)  
  
\*\*8. IVV vs VYM\*\* — The tech-heavy S&P 500 vs a dividend fund anchored  
in financials, healthcare and energy. Which one does the AI favor? The  
breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/ivv-vs-vym-weighing-broad-s-p-500-exposure-against-high-dividend-yield-39506/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/ivv-vs-vym-weighing-broad-s-p-500-exposure-against-high-dividend-yield-39506/)  
  
\*\*9. BALI vs QQQI\*\* — Two covered-call income ETFs, one paying roughly  
14-15% on the Nasdaq-100. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown  
is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/bali-vs-qqqi-comparing-two-covered-call-income-etfs-39743/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/bali-vs-qqqi-comparing-two-covered-call-income-etfs-39743/)  
  
\*\*10. IWD vs IWM\*\* — Large-cap value vs about 1,970 small caps.  
Opposite ends of the market. Which one does the AI favor? The  
breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/iwd-vs-iwm-weighing-large-cap-value-stability-against-small-cap-volatility-39502/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/iwd-vs-iwm-weighing-large-cap-value-stability-against-small-cap-volatility-39502/)  
  
\*\*11. DXJ vs EWJ\*\* — Yen-hedged dividend payers vs plain, unhedged  
Japan. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/dxj-vs-ewj-hedged-dividend-focus-or-broad-unhedged-japan-exposure-39541/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/dxj-vs-ewj-hedged-dividend-focus-or-broad-unhedged-japan-exposure-39541/)  
  
\*\*12. TMFC vs VUG\*\* — About 100 hand-picked growth stocks at 0.50% vs  
about 180 names at 0.04%. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown  
is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/tmfc-vs-vug-weighing-two-large-cap-growth-etfs-39707/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/tmfc-vs-vug-weighing-two-large-cap-growth-etfs-39707/)  
  
Which of these fights is the easiest call for you? The AI's pick is in  
each link.  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
